fields.name: имя ModuleScript / оригинальное название в игре (латиница)
fields.favored: BUFF или DEBUFF — как эффект обычно играется
fields.duration: секунды (число) либо строка для особых случаев
fields.mechanics: техническая суть, вытащенная из кода Applied/Removed/тиков

_meta.note: Проверено чтением исходников всех 41 ModuleScript. Duration=math.huge означает бессрочно. Hidden — скрыт из UI. Instant — мгновенно.

effects.name: Slowness
effects.desc_en: An unnatural weight drags you down. Your movement speed is reduced by 10% per level, and your vision narrows as fatigue sets in.
effects.mechanics: Level 1 = 0.9 скорости, Level 10 = 0. Реализация: SetSpeedCap + FOV-множитель (0.95→0.5).

effects.name: Speed
effects.desc_en: Wind rushes past you. Your movement speed is increased by 10% per level, and your field of view slightly widens to match the pace.
effects.mechanics: Level 10 = ×2.0 скорости. FOV-множитель (1.05→1.5).

effects.name: Corrupted
effects.desc_en: Digital rot infects your code. You take rapid damage over time while your body erupts with glitching red binary particles.
effects.mechanics: Урон по тикам (TimeBetweenTicks + Damage). Визуал: Vignette + ParticleHolder.

effects.name: Stunned
effects.desc_en: A heavy blow leaves you reeling. You are completely immobilized, unable to move, interact, or use abilities for the duration.
effects.mechanics: Полная обездвиженность. timeStackable=false.

effects.name: Glitched
effects.desc_en: Your very existence is corrupted. A portion of your maximum health is permanently blocked and unusable until the effect is cleansed.
effects.mechanics: Блокирует MaxHealth (BlockedPercent за уровень) до очищения.

effects.name: Invisibility
effects.desc_en: Light bends around your form. You become highly translucent, making it incredibly difficult for enemies to spot you in the dark.
effects.mechanics: Сильная полупрозрачность.

effects.name: Undetectable
effects.desc_en: You fade from the killer's senses. Your aura is hidden, and if you are the killer, your terror radius becomes completely silent.
effects.mechanics: Скрывает ауру; у убийцы глушит terror radius.

effects.name: Helpless
effects.desc_en: Panic paralyzes your mind. You are completely stripped of your abilities, unable to use any active skills or items.
effects.mechanics: Отключает активные способности и предметы.

effects.name: Resistance
effects.desc_en: An invisible shield protects you. You receive 20% less damage per level from all incoming attacks.
effects.mechanics: −20% входящего урона за уровень.

effects.name: Weakness
effects.desc_en: Your body feels frail and heavy. You receive 20% more damage per level from all incoming attacks.
effects.mechanics: +20% входящего урона за уровень.

effects.name: Strength
effects.desc_en: Adrenaline surges through your muscles. You deal 20% more damage per level, turning you into a devastating force.
effects.mechanics: +20% исходящего урона за уровень.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.desc_en: Your cells rapidly repair themselves. You continuously restore health over time, scaling with the level of the effect.
effects.mechanics: Heal over time. Визуал: Healing + Vignette.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.desc_en: Toxins course through your veins. You take steady damage over time, and your character's skin turns a sickly, glowing green.
effects.mechanics: Урон по интервалам; кожа светится зелёным. SFX присутствует.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.desc_en: Deep lacerations drain your life. You suffer continuous damage over time, which only stops once you are on the brink of death (10 HP).
effects.mechanics: DoT, останавливается на 10 HP. Единственный среди DoT со Stackable=true.

effects.name: Burning
effects.desc_en: Flames engulf your body. You take rapid damage over time, your screen pulses with heat, and your character is set ablaze.
effects.mechanics: Быстрый DoT, экран пульсирует. Vignette + ParticleHolder + SFX.

effects.name: Slateskin
effects.desc_en: Your flesh turns to living stone. You gain massive overheal and damage resistance, but your movement speed is crippled by 45%.
effects.mechanics: Оверхил + сопротивление, но −45% скорости. Меняет материал/цвет персонажа.

effects.name: Blindness
effects.desc_en: Darkness or blinding light consumes your vision. A heavy blur obscures your surroundings, rendering you practically blind to your environment.
effects.mechanics: Сильный размытый экран. Есть флаг Flash.

effects.name: Disoriented
effects.desc_en: Your equilibrium is destroyed. The camera shakes and distorts unpredictably, making it nearly impossible to aim or navigate properly.
effects.mechanics: Тряска камеры.

effects.name: Deafened
effects.desc_en: A ringing silence fills your ears. You are completely cut off from the killer's terror radius and auditory cues.
effects.mechanics: Отрезает terror radius и звуковые сигналы.

effects.name: Subspaced
effects.desc_en: You are dragged into a chaotic dimension. Your screen is tinted pink with high contrast, vision blurs, and chase themes are muted.
effects.mechanics: Розовый тинт, высокий контраст, блюр, приглушает chase-тему.

effects.name: Inverted
effects.desc_en: Reality flips upside down. Your movement inputs are completely reversed, turning every attempt to flee into a step towards the killer.
effects.mechanics: Инверсия управления движением.

effects.name: Nausea
effects.desc_en: A sickening wave washes over you. Your screen violently sways, stretches, and rolls, with the disorientation worsening at higher levels.
effects.mechanics: Качка/растяжение экрана, усиливается с уровнем.

effects.name: Oblivious
effects.desc_en: You are blind to the danger. You become completely unable to hear the killer's terror radius or chase music, leaving you vulnerable.
effects.mechanics: Не слышит terror radius и chase-музыку.

effects.name: Confusion
effects.desc_en: Your senses are scrambled. Your movement controls are temporarily inverted, making escape and navigation incredibly disorienting.
effects.mechanics: Инверсия управления (вариант Inverted).

effects.name: Exposed
effects.desc_en: A fatal weakness has been revealed. The very next basic attack you receive will be instantly lethal, regardless of your current health.
effects.mechanics: Следующая базовая атака по цели — смертельна при любом HP.

effects.name: Broken
effects.desc_en: Your spirit is shattered. All healing is completely nullified, and regenerative effects are stripped away. Your health cannot be restored.
effects.mechanics: Обнуляет лечение и снимает регенерацию.

effects.name: Obstructed
effects.desc_en: Your focus is shattered. You are completely prevented from using any of your active abilities or items.
effects.mechanics: Полный запрет активных способностей и предметов (аналог Helpless).

effects.name: Cursed
effects.desc_en: A dark affliction plagues you. A random, escalating debuff is forced upon you every few seconds, growing worse at higher levels.
effects.mechanics: Каждые несколько секунд накладывает случайный усиливающийся дебафф.

effects.name: Marked
effects.desc_en: You are prey. Your aura is permanently revealed to all killers, making it impossible to hide in the shadows or behind walls.
effects.mechanics: Аура постоянно раскрыта всем убийцам.

effects.name: Hemorrhaging
effects.desc_en: Your wounds refuse to close. All incoming healing is severely reduced by 50% per level while this effect is active.
effects.mechanics: −50% входящего лечения за уровень.

effects.name: Static
effects.desc_en: Visual interference scrambles your vision. Your screen randomly flashes with chaotic static, distorting brightness, contrast, and color.
effects.mechanics: Случайные вспышки помех на экране.

effects.name: Paranoia
effects.desc_en: Your mind plays tricks on you. Phantom footsteps and eerie sounds echo randomly around you, masking the real threat.
effects.mechanics: Фантомные шаги и звуки маскируют реального убийцу.

effects.name: Silenced
effects.desc_en: The world around you fades into a muffled void. All ambient sounds and music are suppressed, leaving only the sound of your own footsteps.
effects.mechanics: Глушит эмбиент и музыку.

effects.name: Bloodlust
effects.desc_en: The thrill of the hunt takes over. Your movement speed gradually increases the longer you stay close to a survivor, decaying when they escape.
effects.mechanics: Скорость растёт вблизи выжившего, угасает при отрыве (для убийц). math.huge.

effects.name: Unnerving
effects.desc_en: Your mere presence instills dread. Significantly increases your terror radius, making survivors hear your heartbeat from much further away.
effects.mechanics: Увеличивает terror radius (для убийц).

effects.name: Vulnerable
effects.desc_en: Your defenses are compromised. Increases incoming stun duration by 15% per level and marks your body with pulsing, glowing blue wounds.
effects.mechanics: +15% длительности оглушения за уровень; светящиеся синие раны.

effects.name: Timelapsed
effects.desc_en: Time has been altered around you. Applies a black highlight with a bright green outline to the character, making them visible through walls, and activates a particle trail.
effects.mechanics: Чёрный хайлайт с зелёным контуром — видно сквозь стены; партикл-трейл. Условие ParadoxHit.

effects.name: Purrified
effects.desc_en: Cleansed of all negative effects. Grants temporary immunity to statuses, a burst of speed, and damage resistance while emitting a purifying shockwave.
effects.mechanics: Очищает все негативные эффекты: иммунитет + рывок скорости + сопротивление; исцеляющая волна.

effects.name: WallBreaker
effects.desc_en: Each destroyed wall strengthens its consequences. Breaking barriers empowers your relentless pursuit.
effects.mechanics: Каждая сломанная стена усиливает эффект (для убийц). Точные числа в Data не заданы.

effects.name: ParadoxHit
effects.desc_en: A temporal echo of Chronos's blade. Ability cooldowns are extended as if the hit just landed.
effects.mechanics: Продлевает кулдауны способностей (эхо удара Хроноса). Hidden=true, накладывает Timelapsed. Duration/Penalty — аргументы, не константы.

effects.name: Haste
effects.desc_en: Your limbs move on their own, wired to a faster rhythm. Ability and attack cooldowns recharge 8% faster per level.
effects.mechanics: −8% к кулдаунам способностей и атак за уровень.
